key_insight: EdgeDAM achieves distractor-aware single-object tracking on mobile devices by removing heavy mask-prediction components and replacing them with a lightweight, attention-efficient memory mechanism that enables real-time performance with robust target localization.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between high-accuracy, distractor-aware trackers (which rely on segmentation and attention-heavy memory updates) and the need for low-latency, resource-efficient SOT on edge/mobile devices facing occlusion, distractors, and fast motion.
method: Replace mask-based distractor handling with a compact, feature- or bbox-level distractor-aware memory that avoids costly segmentation.
Use attention-efficient memory update rules and a lightweight visual backbone to preserve robustness while reducing compute.
Optimize for edge deployment through model compression and latency-aware pipeline design (e.g., pruning/quantization and inference scheduling).
impact: Makes robust single-object tracking practical on phones and other edge devices, enabling real-time AR, robotics, and surveillance use-cases while lowering compute, latency, and power requirements.

paper_title: EdgeDAM: Real-time Object Tracking for Mobile Devices
paper_authors: Syed Muhammad Raza, Syed Murtaza Hussain Abidi, Khawar Islam, Muhammad Ibrahim, Ajmal Saeed Mian
